body:
Adds the coefficients of the Raupach (1994) canopy roughness model, which SurfaceFluxes.jl's `RaupachRoughnessParams` exposes as fields ([CliMA/SurfaceFluxes.jl#270](https://github.com/CliMA/SurfaceFluxes.jl/pull/270)), with the defaults of the paper:

| Parameter | Field | Default |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `raupach_element_drag_coefficient` | `C_R` | 0.3 |
| `raupach_substrate_drag_coefficient` | `C_S` | 0.003 |
| `raupach_displacement_coefficient` | `c_d1` | 7.5 |
| `raupach_frontal_area_ratio` | `frontal_area_ratio` | 0.5 |
| `raupach_minimum_frontal_area_index` | `λ_min` | 0.0 |
| `raupach_max_ustar_to_canopy_wind_ratio` | `ustar_Uh_max` | 0.3 |
| `raupach_roughness_sublayer_depth_ratio` | `c_w` | 2.0 |

Patch release v1.3.1.
title: Add Raupach (1994) canopy roughness parameters
